question: Q018. Considering the analysis of a storage disk, which of the following statement would you use to explain what the <u>non-indexed</u> space is (select <u>the most fitting</u> option)?
answers: It is the space where Reallocation occurs when a sector is damaged.
It is a memory space which was occupied by a file that has been removed.
It is a write-protected space on the disk that cannot be overwritten.
It is the space within a sector between the end of the contained file and the end of the corresponding sector.

question: Q040. Considering the analysis of a storage disk, which of the following statement would you use to explain what the <u>slack space</u> is (select <u>the most fitting</u> option)?
answers: It is the space within a sector between the end of the contained file and the end of the corresponding sector.
It is the memory space included within a geometrical sector.
It is a non-allocated memory space that can be overwritten by a file.
It is a memory space which is not indexed anymore since the table of indexes has been lost with file removal.
